description: Figure 3 is a stacked bar chart illustrating the distribution of datasets by year, categorized by conceptualized and operationalized targets. The horizontal category axis, labeled "Year," displays discrete years arranged in chronological order from 2012 to 2022. The vertical value axis, labeled "Number of datasets," utilizes a linear scale ranging from 0 to 160, with horizontal gridlines and numeric tick labels spaced at intervals of 20. The chart features stacked bars for each year, where the visual arrangement consists of a bottom segment colored blue representing "Untargeted" datasets, and a top segment colored orange representing "Targeted" datasets, as defined by the inset legend titled "Targets." The total height of the stacked bars consistently increases from left to right between 2012 and 2021; the shortest bar occurs in 2012 with an approximate total value of 1 (consisting entirely of untargeted datasets), while the tallest bar occurs in 2021, reaching a total value of approximately 160 (comprising roughly 68 untargeted and 92 targeted datasets). The final bar for the year 2022 is visually emphasized using faded, lighter shades of blue and orange, reaching an approximate total value of 38 datasets.
